title: Virtual Card Management: Managing Multiple Virtual Cards for Your Team
summary: Explains how to manage multiple virtual cards for a team, including maintaining up to 60 active virtual cards per account, using custom nicknames for labeling, setting per-card spending limits from $55 to $30,000, and using recurring-use cards for subscriptions. It also covers monthly review plus archiving/canceling or reassigning cards linked to completed projects.
faqs: What is the maximum number of active virtual cards I can keep per account?
How should I label virtual cards to make audits and reviews easier?
What spending limits can I set per virtual card (and what range is allowed)?
When should I use recurring-use virtual cards for vendors or subscriptions?
How often should I review virtual card usage and update card ownership/purpose?
What should I do with cards tied to completed projects to stay under the 60-card limit?
keywords: Up to 60 active virtual cards per account
Reassign or cancel cards after project completion
